description: Free: the same verification as verify_payment, limited to 3 NEW claims per client per day (asking again about a claim already checked is always free).

invoiceId.description: XRPL only: the InvoiceID (64 hex) the payment must carry; binds the answer and its signed receipt to your invoice

logIndex.description: Bind to one transfer: its position within the tx's logs

minAmountRaw.description: Minimum amount in base units, e.g. "50000" = 0.05 USDC (default: any). XRPL: XRP drops, or millionths of an issued currency

payee.description: Address that should have received the money (XRPL: an r... account)

payer.description: Only count transfers from this address (the token holder who paid)

requiredLevel.description: Proof level you need before releasing money (Base: tee_attested < zk_proven < resolved; Ethereum: finalized; XRPL: unl_quorum). The answer then says whether it is releasable.

token.description: ERC-20 contract (default: USDC on the chain). XRPL: RLUSD (default), XRP, or CURRENCY.rIssuer

name: try_verify_payment
